concerns.text: The plan uses the same verified HEALPix CMB dataset as a placeholder for the galaxy‑density map ("proxy galaxy‑density map"), which does not measure the construct of galaxy density. This undermines construct validity for the core hypothesis that CMB cold spots correlate with *under‑dense* regions in the large‑scale structure.

Because the real‑world analysis relies on a galaxy‑density field derived from the CMB temperature map itself, any shared systematic or noise will induce spurious correlations. This confound is not controlled or modeled, violating the requirement for independent probes and threatening the causal interpretation of any observed ξ(θ).
